the_rule.statement: Any criterion, estimand, threshold or inclusion rule ISSUED BY THE ADJUDICATOR must pass an OD-017 implementation conformance check before it may enter a pre-registration. The adjudicator's instruction does not exempt it from verification.
the_rule.enforcement: a criterion that has not been compared against the relevant live implementation may not be registered, whatever its source
the_rule.scope: every registered criterion, including and especially those handed down rather than authored by the executing party

why_it_exists.the_precipitating_event: the P-0' directive prescribed replacing the estimand with a logit-difference recovery ratio; that formula is algebraically identical to the one P-0 was already using
why_it_exists.how_it_was_caught: OD-017 entry 0.estimand_is_a_replacement, which compared the PRESCRIBED formula against the implemented one rather than comparing each tool to its own registration
why_it_exists.the_adjudicator_s_own_account: the prescription was written from recollection of the literature and was not checked against the implementation
why_it_exists.the_general_fault: a conformance regime that audits only the executing party's code against the executing party's registration cannot detect a defect that entered through the instruction itself
why_it_exists.what_would_have_happened_without_it: the identical estimand would have been re-run under a new name, reproducing the identical defect, while the record stated that an estimand had been replaced

relation_to_OD_017.OD-017_says: before any pre-registered criterion is applied to data, a line-by-line conformance table of registered text against implemented behaviour must be produced and committed, comparing live values
relation_to_OD_017.OD-021_extends_it: the comparison must also run in the direction of an incoming instruction, not only from a tool to its own registration

relation_to_the_directionality_precedent.the_precedent: changing the implementation to match the registered text is a bug fix; changing the registered text to match the data is p-hacking
relation_to_the_directionality_precedent.how_OD_021_sits_beside_it: the precedent governs what may be changed after a result is seen; OD-021 governs what must be checked before anything is registered at all. Neither substitutes for the other

first_application.what_it_governs_here: every candidate estimand on the pre-declared shortlist, every inclusion rule, the accuracy floor and the unit floor
first_application.consequence_recorded_in_advance: a candidate that fails its check is out; it is not repaired to make it pass

claim_ceiling: A governance rule. It licenses no claim of any kind.
